note: Named Central Hub NPCs (appearance and one idle only). The three models are OpenTrident MakeHuman V2 bodies on the 106-joint Mixamo rig with their 12 clips replaced by ONE retargeted Mixamo idle each (art/hub-npcs/build.mjs), registered in assets/manifest-hollow.json as deferred rows. Nothing draws them yet and nothing reads this file: placement, interaction and dialogue belong to the Hub wiring PR (Lead, World, WebUI), which is also expected to honour enabled false or ?nonpcs=1 as the off switch, and to drive the idle clock itself (DonorMotion holds a standing human at phase 0). bodySha256 is the sha256 of OpenTrident's delivered body (art/hub-npcs/assets.json); the shipped file differs only by its clip.
